sources_admitted.evidence: Patch captures through the registry: CENTCOM launch, Senate Appropriations July 21 hearing, House and Senate hostilities votes, House Budget H.Con.Res. 113, DoD IG listing, Brown energy brief, CSIS Last Rounds, AP U.N. mission; DCAS served only a title. Round 3: AP and Reuters September 18 dispatches via U.S. News, Stars and Stripes July 21, CRS R42699 from congress.gov; the Washington Post served a stub and the Senate video page served no transcript.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: Elapsed days February 28 to August 1 and March 5 to September 15 from dated records; munitions share 21.7/38.1 and Q2 energy share 2.3/5.3 computed in the data module from those CBO figures.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: Reuters mislabels the inspector general's date and what its total includes; its $3 billion month is one of CBO's two paths. ABC's end-of-July wording is consistent with CBO's August 1 cutoff. Military Times's to date is unconfirmed against Stars and Stripes and CBO's through-September wording. NBC's share checks out as arithmetic from CBO's two inputs.

section_grammar.evidence: What happened, the catch, where this sits, who feels it, outlets, claim check, what happened next, unknowns, records, with figures from the data module and a chronology table.

chip_vocabulary.evidence: Chips are mislabeled, unconfirmed, consistent, checks out, and single outlet, from the closed set; the count line carries a one-line key.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: No live counter on the page; KPI values are from the CBO letter and do not tick.
